comments.P: Press-room marketing with coral registration mark, three named edition slots, and honest Ferry Board needed-state. Strong brief fit and anti-cliché; composition/type less fully specified than T or S.
comments.Q: Night-watch instrument, always-on status strip, amber-only-for-faults, and validation/offline/success hierarchy are product-console vocabulary, not coastal print portfolio. Signature misfits the mode; composition is only object-left/type-right.
comments.R: Portfolio Grid + Neo Brutalism with Space Grotesk and pink/cyan system palette fights pack brand and characterful letterpress marketing — template retrieval. Signature is a mark name without mechanism.
comments.S: Ferry-terminal departure board is the most memorable island-true direction: three edition rows, coral registration lamp on active row, view→facts→enquire as columns. Implementability slightly softer because split-flap cascade must stay honest when paper/size facts are still unknown.
comments.T: Locked chase on the platen is the deepest print-production grounding: chase frame, job-ticket rail, coral registration cross as sole accent grammar, honest pending Ferry Board. Clearest desktop-tolerant ship candidate.
